items.title: AWS Introduces Specification Driven Composition for Flexible Data Workflows
items.summary: AWS describes a specification-driven approach for composing flexible data workflows by separating intent from processing logic. Architecture uses declarative specifications, reusable processing capabilities, and validation before execution. AWS reports that the approach can reduce dataset onboarding from weeks to days while supporting traceability, versioning, data classification, and governance. By Leela Kumili

It maintains compatibility with the unified ecosystem while offering faster parsing and reduced dependencies. By Daniel Curtis
